pure_extracted_method_probe.scope: Unmodified source AST methods executed with controlled version/platform and synthetic identical PrimFunc.script(), without importing TileLang, TVM, Torch or compiling a kernel. This is a cache contract counterexample, not an observed real vLLM collision.

proof.loading_contract: Complete old cache entries are accepted after self-integrity hashes/size checks and compatible adapter loading; those hashes bind cached artifacts to their own manifest, not to the active compiler. Incompatible or corrupted entries can miss/recompile, but there is no unconditional compiler-source/library invalidation.
proof.prepare_freeze_limit: vLLM tilelang.prepare invokes JIT before freezing; cache.cached can load disk artifacts before freeze. Freeze prevents later undeclared loads/compiles; it does not prove which compiler produced prepared artifacts.
proof.normalization_limit: Changed front-end lowering, pass configs, targets or TIR strings can alter individual keys. No claim that every C40/C42 key collides; a single compatible shared entry is enough to make blanket fresh-compiler qualification unproven.
proof.native_environment: Parent-provided compact Docker inspection reports C42 release container on image70e9..., TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/c/tilelang-release-tests and /c=/home/swank/.cache/spark-lab/compile, with no lib-stamp flag. This review did not independently access a node.

lib_stamp_caveat.default: Both old b95 env and C42 env default TILELANG_KERNEL_CACHE_USE_LIB_STAMP=0.
lib_stamp_caveat.discovery: _get_tilelang_lib_stamp scans TL_LIBS and takes the first matching libtilelang.so, libtvm_runtime.so and libtvm_compiler.so by basename; it does not compare these to loaded DSO handles or /proc/self/maps and returns None when no stamp is found.
lib_stamp_caveat.common_wheel_case: C42 env defaults TL_LIBS to the installed tilelang/lib and initializes TVM_LIBRARY_PATH from it only when not already set. TileLang loader uses libinfo.find_lib_path over TL_LIBS. An explicitly overridden TVM_LIBRARY_PATH may therefore select a different actual TVM library than the stamp scan.
lib_stamp_caveat.required_if_selected: Prove stamp paths/hashes exactly cover tilelang._LIB_PATH, tvm.base._LIB._name and relevant mapped compiler/runtime DSOs; reject absent/mismatched coverage rather than silently falling back. Also include compiler Python/build inputs or a source namespace if the policy must cover Python-only compiler changes.

disposition.current_round: Finish only the current gate job through normal requested closure, retain actual image/steps/exit/restoration and no serving/performance verdict. Do not edit frozen source/spec/environment/cache mid-run, delete shared caches, silently resume, or label this an observed compiler/performance failure.

recommendation.preferred: If continuing is justified, use one explicit corrected qualification candidate, separate from reserved C43 frontend cleanup. A minimal experimental compiler packaging/source VERSION namespace tied to the immutable ten-patch compiler tree is safer/smaller than blindly changing global stamp defaults. Example0.1.15+snapshot.bae5fe12b58cdf364efeccbabc04cd08205c43b9 refers to the pre-metadata compiler tree, avoiding a self-referential version hash. Preserve all ten authored patches, add only the identity correction, update experiment lock/manifest/version/source head/tree and build a distinct immutable image. This is a provenance/control correction, not an algorithmic optimization or reset of the compiler rework allowance.
recommendation.why_new_image: A profile-only unique cache directory is a smaller declarative isolation mechanism, but cannot retroactively validate the already-run shared-cache vLLM gate. Under the strict no-repeat rule, do not rerun that completed gate or old image. A genuine explicit package-identity correction creates a new source/image qualification with its own first gates; retain C42 as unqualified for compiler-wide provenance.
recommendation.version_mechanism: Docker builds with NO_VERSION_LABEL=1; version_provider.dynamic_metadata returns the literal VERSION in that mode. KernelCache namespace and key include tilelang.__version__, so a unique pinned local version prevents lookup of0.1.15 entries. No math/compiler pass changes are needed for this option.
required_controls: Use the full immutable pre-metadata source tree in the version suffix; record both pre-metadata and resulting patched source head/tree. Do not create a self-referential hash. The proposed namespace is not valid until actual-image installed/base-key checks confirm it.
Before new qualification, verify new cache namespace is absent on each participating node; preserve old caches untouched.

In each actual-image fresh feature process and a serving startup identity receipt, assert tilelang.__version__ == importlib.metadata.version(tilelang) == pinned unique version and record actual _get_base_key and _get_cache_namespace.
Verify installed wheel module/library hashes and actual loaded DSO paths remain in the intended image/package; preserve current no-source-overlay rule.
All new-source image/release/functional gates and both unchanged full metric boots still required; no inherited component result or source identity alone establishes qualification.
If an actual compiler correctness/performance miss remains after the bounded corrected qualification, highlight/drop rather than create another algorithmic retry.

After normal C42 completion, preserve actual wait exit and all gate statuses and independently verify all-rank C36 restoration before releasing/fulfilling only matching own requests or opening any corrected candidate window. Re-read foreign holds/requests before staging C44.
recommendation.alternative: A narrowly scoped default-on library-stamp source patch is defensible only after exact loaded-library coverage and fail-closed behavior are implemented/tested; changing the default flag alone is not sufficient proof. Pure declarative cache-root isolation should be retained as defense in depth, not used to excuse the already unisolated release gate.
recommendation.new_candidate_scope: Potential C44 compiler provenance correction on unchanged default-enabled corrected C40 vLLM; C43 frontend lifetime packet remains separate and unfrozen.
strict_rule_limits: This proposal is justified by the demonstrated package/cache-identity defect, not a metadata-only attempt to evade a failed performance mark. C42 has no serving point to repeat, and no observed compiler performance/correctness failure is asserted.

It requires a genuine published new source/head/tree, pinned installed version and distinct immutable OCI image; retagging C42 or changing a running cache directory is insufficient. New-source gates are that new image’s first gates; do not repeat a completed gate on C42.

The extra protocol correction does not reset or expand the compiler’s prior algorithmic rework allowance. An actual correctness/performance miss in the corrected qualification should be highlighted/dropped rather than spawning another algorithmic candidate.

If the owner’s no-gate-repeat rule were interpreted to forbid the same validation workload even for a genuinely corrected new source/image, no new candidate could be qualified under that interpretation. The proposal relies on the already authorized corrected-candidate/new-source qualification workflow, not an exception for rerunning C42.
No compiler pass, arithmetic, kernel policy, topology, cooling limit or performance tolerance changes are justified by this review. Existing exact ten authored patches remain unchanged.
